T: The ride was hard. The tucker was better.
D: A young man proves himself as a horseman in the Australian high country.
P: Serve the mains when Jim rides down the mountain after the brumbies.
S: Oven-baked damper loaf with butter and golden syrup
Self-raising flour, salt and butter rubbed together, milk mixed in with a knife, shaped into a round, baked at 200C for 30 minutes until hollow when tapped. Butter and golden syrup.
Sliced corned silverside with English mustard and pickles on buttered bread
Corned silverside simmered 3 hours with onion, carrot and peppercorns, cooled, sliced thin onto buttered bread with hot English mustard and pickles.

Slow-braised lamb shoulder with onion, rosemary and gravy in shortcrust pastry with flaky lids, hot pies with tomato sauce for the saddlebag. Brown 800g diced lamb shoulder, add 1 onion, rosemary, 1 tbsp flour, 400ml beef stock and Worcestershire. Cover and simmer gently 2 hours, then shred and cool. Line 6 pie tins with 2 sheets shortcrust pastry, fill, top with lids cut from 2 sheets puff pastry and crimp. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.
M: Lamb, carrot, potato and rosemary stew. No wallaby
Lamb shoulder chops browned in a camp oven, onion, carrot, potato and stock, covered and simmered over coals or at 160C for 2.5 hours, rosemary and parsley.

Beef sirloin roasted pink and carved at the table, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and pumpkin, horseradish cream and red wine gravy. Season a 1.5kg beef sirloin and roast at 200C for 40 minutes until 52C inside, then rest 20 minutes. Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Whisk 140g flour, 3 eggs and 250ml milk, pour into 12 hot oiled muffin holes and bake at 230C for 20 minutes. Make gravy with the juices, 125ml red wine and 300ml stock. Mix 150g sour cream with horseradish.
W: Steamed currant pudding with golden syrup and custard

Self-raising flour, suet or butter, sugar and currants mixed with milk, wrapped in a floured cloth, steamed 2 hours. Rub 100g butter into 250g self-raising flour, stir in 75g sugar and 150g currants, then add 150ml milk to a soft dough. Wrap in a floured cloth or basin and steam for 2 hours. Serve with golden syrup and custard.
K: Loose leaf tea boiled in a billy, served with milk and sugar

Water boiled in a billy, tea leaves thrown in, a gum leaf if you have one, swung around to settle, poured into tin mugs with milk and sugar. Boil 1.2L water in a billy or pot. Throw in 3 tbsp loose leaf tea and a gum leaf if you have one, take it off the heat and swing it round to settle the leaves. Pour into tin mugs with milk and sugar.

dishes.make_ahead: Best the day it is baked

steps.text: Rub a portion of the butter into the flour and salt.
Mix in the milk with a knife, shape into a round and score the top.
Bake at 200C until it sounds hollow.
Serve warm with the remaining butter and golden syrup.

dishes.make_ahead: Beef up to 3 days, assemble on the day

steps.text: Put the beef in a pot with the halved onion, carrot and peppercorns, cover with water and bring to a simmer.
Simmer gently, then leave to cool in the liquid.
Butter the bread, slice the beef thin and layer with mustard and pickles.

veg.n: High country roast beetroot and cheddar sandwiches
veg.make_ahead: Beetroot up to 3 days, assemble on the day

steps.text: Wrap the beetroot in foil with the oil, salt and crushed peppercorns and roast at 200C until tender.
Cool, rub off the skins and slice thin.
Butter the bread and layer with the beetroot, cheddar, mustard and pickles.
Chop the onions, carrots and potatoes into chunks.
Brown the lamb in a heavy pot in batches.
Add the vegetables, stock and rosemary, cover and cook over coals or at 160C until the lamb is tender.
Finish with chopped parsley.

veg.n: Camp oven mushroom and lentil stew

steps.text: Chop the onions, carrots and potatoes into chunks.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in a heavy pot in batches.
Add the vegetables, lentils, stock, soy and rosemary, cover and cook over coals or at 160C until the lentils are tender.
Finish with chopped parsley.

dishes.make_ahead: Pudding up to 1 day, reheat by steaming

steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour, then stir in the sugar and currants.
Add the milk to make a soft dough and wrap in a floured cloth or put in a basin.
Steam until firm and cooked through.
Slice and serve with golden syrup and warm custard.

dishes.make_ahead: Best made fresh in the billy; nothing to do ahead except measure out the tea and sugar

steps.text: Boil the water in a billy or pot.
Throw in the tea and a gum leaf if you have one, take it off the heat and swing it round to settle the leaves.
Pour into tin mugs with milk and sugar.

s.note: Oven-baked damper loaf with butter and golden syrup
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt. Mix in about 300ml milk with a knife, shape into a round and score the top. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve with butter and golden syrup.

s.note: Sliced corned silverside with English mustard and pickles on buttered bread
s.how: Simmer a 1.2kg corned silverside with an onion, a carrot and peppercorns for 3 hours, then cool in the liquid. Slice thin onto 8 slices buttered white bread with English mustard and mustard pickles.

m.note: Lamb, carrot, potato and rosemary stew. No wallaby
m.how: Brown 1.2kg lamb shoulder chops in a heavy pot. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, 600g potatoes and 750ml stock with rosemary. Cover and simmer over coals or at 160C for 2.5 hours. Finish with chopped parsley.

w.note: Steamed currant pudding with golden syrup and custard
w.how: Rub 100g butter into 250g self-raising flour, stir in 75g sugar and 150g currants, then add 150ml milk to a soft dough. Wrap in a floured cloth or basin and steam for 2 hours. Serve with golden syrup and custard.

d.note: Loose leaf tea boiled in a billy, served with milk and sugar
d.how: Boil 1.2L water in a billy or pot. Throw in 3 tbsp loose leaf tea and a gum leaf if you have one, take it off the heat and swing it round to settle the leaves. Pour into tin mugs with milk and sugar.
